specs.name: CPU
specs.value: Raspberry Pi® CM5/CM5Lite; BCM2712 Quad(4) Core Cortex-A76 at 2.4GHz

specs.name: Storage
specs.value: Internal M.2 NVMe connector for SSD card (optional)

specs.name: Display
specs.value: 15.6” IPS LCD, 1920 x 1080 px, brightness 350 cd/m2

specs.name: USB
specs.value: 2 x USB 3.0 Host, 1 x Type-C USB (Slave)

specs.name: PCIe
specs.value: M.2 2280 M-key, PCIe Gen 2.0 x1 (PCIe Gen 3.0 x1 is compatible but experimental) (optional)

specs.name: Audio
specs.value: 2W internal stereo speaker, 3.5mm audio Out connector

specs.name: RTC
specs.value: High accuracy RTC with farad capacitor, can work 1 week after power off (default). High accuracy RTC with lithium coin battery, can work 3 years after power off (optional).

specs.name: WiFi/BT
specs.value: WiFi/BT module comes with the CM5

specs.name: Micro SD card socket
specs.value: 1 x TF(micro SD) card slot, only for CM5 Lite module to boot from TF

specs.name: HDMI
specs.value: HDMI 2.0 connector, can be driven up to 4K 60FPS
